newsitem.title: USA: Simula stock sold in private placement.
newsitem.headline: Simula stock sold in private placement.

text.p: Simula Inc on Tuesday said three charitable trusts formed by Stan Desjardins, the company's founder and chairman, sold 200,000 of its common shares to institutional investors seeking long-term positions in Simula.
The sale represents substantially all the shares owned by the trusts, and is within requirements to invest in income-producing assets, Simula said in a statement.
Simula, which makes crash safety and energy absorbing products, including aircraft seating, will not receive any proceeds from the sale.
Simula shares were up 3/8 at 19-1/8 early Tuesday afternoon.
